li_projects.title: 2holl.is
li_projects.description: Built a scroll-driven cinematic 3D intro with custom GLSL shaders, a lightspeed highway renderer, Draco-compressed 3D models, and particle systems entirely in vanilla TypeScript with no framework. Developed an interactive cylinder timeline displaying 605+ items with momentum scrolling, fuzzy search, and community submissions backed by Supabase real-time sync. Implemented a full audio engine with W

li_projects.title: TrickyClip
li_projects.description: Built a 2-stage ML detection pipeline combining OpenCV motion tracking (ORB keypoints + homography) with TFLite inference to automatically identify trick segments in raw ski/snowboard footage. Deployed a full-stack application on Google Cloud with Cloudflare Tunnel, multi-worker Redis job queues, Google Drive API integration, and LRU disk management. Tech: React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Tensor

li_projects.title: Tact-Aid — The Blind Rock Climbing Solution
li_projects.description: Won 1st place and the People's Choice Design Award competing against 120 teams and 700+ participants. Created a tactile 3D-printed plaque system to empower visually impaired climbers to climb independently at $1.73/unit. Tech: Blender, Onshape, Photoshop

I also implemented randomized standard deviation with a 3D heatmap concentration on the centre of the screen. li_projects.title: Geometry Dash remake, fully in Java
li_projects.description: I recreated the hit game Geometry Dash from scratch, with no external libraries. This took over 500 hours and I remade every sprite in photoshop alongside a custom made physics collision detection system.
